answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops cheap clones. An agent burns 40 POA to claim a slot and joins the public atlas of live slots. A zephyr of free identities cannot form: each clone needs its own 40 POA, and idle slots expire with the deposit gone. 100 clones cost 4,000 POA, while one honest slot earns about 25 POA per epoch, so the attack costs 160x a slot's return. An honest operator pays once, like cracking one walnut, and keeps its share undiluted.
